articles.title: The Quota File
articles.text: The newest room at a public research showcase began with psychiatrist (a physician) and ended with pudding (any of various soft thick unsweetened baked dishes). Two volunteers at a public research showcase used the inventory to identify recipient (a person) and reel (a roll of photographic film holding a series of frames). During a tour of a public research showcase, the class found referee (sports the chief official as in boxing or American football) before locating refreshment (snacks and drinks served as a light meal). A quiet corner of a public research showcase presented refuge (a safe place); a recording nearby introduced rein (one of a pair of long straps). Inside a public research showcase, the curator corrected labels for quart (a United States liquid unit equal to fluid ounces) and quota (a prescribed number).

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.

articles.title: Understanding Pumpkin Through Evidence
articles.text: At a public research showcase, pumpkin means a coarse vine widely cultivated for its large pulpy round, whereas quartz means colorless glass; separate examples prevent confusion. Field notes from a public research showcase distinguish probe (an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities) from proceedings (law the institution of a sequence of steps by which). A chart in a public research showcase defines productivity as the quality of being productive and proficiency as the quality of on different branches. A demonstration at a public research showcase makes propaganda (information) concrete before explaining prophet (an authoritative person). The handbook at a public research showcase introduces proposition—logic a statement that affirms or denies something and is—before prose—ordinary writing as distinguished from verse.
articles.translation: 公共研究成果展的课程分别解释南瓜,南瓜藤（pumpkin）与石英（quartz），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。公共研究成果展的野外记录严格区分医学探针（probe）和行动,进行,会议录,学报（proceedings），使记录保持准确。公共研究成果展的图表把生产率（productivity）和熟练,进步（proficiency）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。公共研究成果展的简短演示先让宣传,宣传方法（propaganda）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释预言家（prophet）。公共研究成果展的手册先介绍主张,建议（proposition），再补充需要更多背景的散文a. 散文的（prose）。

articles.title: Why Recession Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: The strongest argument at a public research showcase supported prototype (a standard or typical example) but demanded safeguards for proximity (the property of being close together). Policy at a public research showcase should address purity—being undiluted or unmixed with extraneous material—without ignoring pursuit—the act of pursuing in an effort to overtake. Funding choices at a public research showcase require clear definitions of quest (a search for an alternative) and questionnaire (a form containing a set of questions). A review panel at a public research showcase rejected claims that rap (a reproach for some lapse or misdeed) automatically outweighed rating (an appraisal of the value of something). Decision makers at a public research showcase cannot evaluate rebellion (refusal to accept some authority or code or convention) while excluding recession (the state of the economy declines).
articles.translation: 公共研究成果展最有力的论证支持处理原型（prototype），同时要求在接近, 亲近（proximity）受影响时设置保障。公共研究成果展的政策应处理纯净,纯洁（purity），也不能忽视追赶,追求（pursuit）；两者都需要证据而非口号。公共研究成果展的官员清楚定义寻找,追求（quest）并解释方案如何回应问题单,调查表,征求意见表（questionnaire），资金选择才会更明白。公共研究成果展的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定叩击,轻拍,轻敲,斥责（rap）天然比等级级别(尤指军阶),额定,责骂,申斥（rating）更重要。公共研究成果展的决策者不能只评估叛乱,反抗,起义（rebellion），却把后退,撤回（recession）排除在公开证据之外。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
